observations.observation: Visible source unit is mg. Image-only low/high and normalized source-only audit correct Omega/Xi-like native symbols to mg. Reinspection confirms a content correction; bold styling differs. Core CDM increases 0.778 to 1.0. Raw frozen repair arms remain the native string after their original rollback.
observations.decision: Useful source-grounded development proposal; no aggregate gain or held-out claim.

observations.observation: Source and reference have A subscripted and C on the baseline. Native string puts AC together in the subscript. Fresh official CDM visualization reproduces F1=1.0 with 12 matched/reference/prediction tokens despite that visible structural difference. The image-only response also moves /3 and closing punctuation into the exponent and scores 0.96.
observations.decision: CDM matching is not literal structural correctness; retain independent structure audit before using it as an acceptance label or sole reward.

observations.observation: Source has a short visible overbar absent from the frozen released reference. The normalized source-only audit changes p_c to Pc and drops the overbar and closing parenthesis; core CDM rises 0.8 to 0.923. Fresh visualization confirms missing parenthesis and overbar.
observations.decision: Reference-agreement improvement with material source disagreement; not a demonstrated visually correct repair. Do not relabel frozen annotations.
